message:
Fixed #37357 -- Handled out-of-range year in admin date_hierarchy.

ChangeList.get_filters() only caught ValueError around the datetime()
construction, leaving the to_date computation outside the try. An
out-of-range year query parameter (e.g. ?date__year=9999, where
to_date's year + 1 == 10000) or a value too large for a C long
(OverflowError) escaped as an unhandled exception (HTTP 500) instead of
IncorrectLookupParameters. Catch both exceptions and compute to_date
inside the try, matching the handling already used in
views/generic/dates.py and elsewhere.
